gates.name: Future migration
gates.command: bash deploy/test-future-migration.sh (Windows environment adapter supplies Python3 and confines temporary cleanup)

developmentFindings.gate: First complete MySQL profile before correction
developmentFindings.resolution: Retain database locks while detaching/reloading managed aggregates; use current locking reads for Event context and charge lookup. Same regression cases subsequently passed.

acceptanceCoverage.BACK_464: All Event contexts, active/finished/archived, audit/amount preservation, paid/pending payments, repeated cancellation, another Event isolation and transactional rollback.
acceptanceCoverage.BACK_465: Days 29/30/31, full late-confirmation window, exact expiration/request/approval boundaries, duplicate prevention and rejected receipts.
acceptanceCoverage.BACK_466: Open/paid/pending financial facts retained by explicit policy; personal pending guests rejected, accepted offers declined, approved guest controlled conflict, registration remains canceled after payment.

securityAndContracts: Existing method/path/DTO/permission and ownership contracts preserved; full verify includes Billing/Events OpenAPI and HTTP/security suites.
migrations: None. V1-V4 unchanged; V5 remains available in the release ancestry.
reviewPoints: Individual withdrawal preserves debt and uses the existing Billing refund request flow; review business policy.
Approved guest blocks withdrawal. No new undo-approval endpoint is provided.
Accepted ride offer becomes DECLINED and retains its original response time; no new withdrawal-specific history vocabulary.
Locking reload performs additional queries; production-scale load testing was not performed.
Full retention policy is tracked separately under BACK-487.
